answer: Agents lock collateral in the kernel to vote, and weight tracks stake, not account count: splitting one balance across Sybil ids buys no extra power. Slashing is correlated, so one detected cheat burns the whole pool and each fake id becomes a liability. To fake a quorum an attacker must fund every account, paying the same total as one honest staker while multiplying slash risk. Honest work earns nectar rewards and ivory reputation that accrue only with age, so churning throwaway ids forfeits both. Sybil cost rises with identity count while payoff stays flat.
